answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity bonded to a verifiable off-chain credential, like a signed field-survey attestation. Each new agent must lock tokens plus a unique credential; forging duplicates costs the full stake, which peers slash on detection. Duplicate registrations then burn capital faster than any reward from a tundra deployment or a yarrow cultivation license could repay, and the loss compounds across every canyon of the network where the fake identity tries to earn.
